title: PF2e - Wayfinder Character Builder
description:
A guided Pathfinder 2e character builder, built into Foundry.

Wayfinder turns PF2E character creation and leveling into a single guided flow you open from the character sheet. Ancestry, heritage, background, class, branch picks, normal and Free Archetype feats, boosts, skill increases, spell choices, and reviewed Starting Equipment — all in one place, with earlier picks narrowing later options where Wayfinder can verify the rule.

Unlike standalone planners, Wayfinder lives inside your world. It respects enabled sources where it has support, writes supported guided results directly to the actor, and hands you back to the PF2E sheet for optional variants or choices it can't model confidently. Starting Equipment is creation-time acquisition under GM policy, not an ongoing shop; actors with unresolved or foreign wealth receive a zero-write handoff. No JSON export, no re-import, fewer sheet-mismatch loops.

Who it's for:

  • New PF2E players — every step explains what you're choosing and why those options are available.
  • Returning players — search, pick, next; resumable drafts let you plan multiple levels at once.
  • GMs onboarding friends — players self-serve inside Foundry with rules and sources matching your table.

Status: early access, built slice by slice. Class coverage and supported choice surfaces are tracked in the readme. Where Wayfinder can't guide a required step, it says so and points you to the right native PF2E control instead of applying as though unsupported work was handled.
